risks_remaining.risk: The baseline e581219 service process is no longer running (no PID observed at report generation). The remediation branch is not deployed to production runtime; it exists only as code and tests. Owner action is required to restart from the remediation branch before any live trading session.

BROKER_WHATIF_PASS was obtained while the market was closed in prior Oct 1 validation, so IBKR returned DBL_MAX margin sentinels and zero commission. The round trip to IBKR is proven (authoritative warningText returned, 1 whatIfOrder transmitted PAPER-only), but margin/commission computation for a combo during live session is NOT proven. A during-session re-validation is recommended before operational promotion.

Combo margin and commission computation by IBKR for a BAG order during live market session has not been end-to-end validated. The DBL_MAX sentinel detection is unit-tested but not exercised against a live IBKR whatIf response for a real BAG.

The orchestration decision treats PREMARKET as a non-trading session. If the experiment is ever intended to act premarket, that policy must be revisited by the Owner; it was chosen because the market-data gate already requires MarketSession.REGULAR.

explicitly_not_proven: Combo margin and commission computation by IBKR for a BAG order during live market session.
That a live Monday session resumes correctly in production; this is proven deterministically by tests, not by a live session.
Any claim about the model's trading quality, strategy, or profitability. No strategy, symbol, threshold, or universe was introduced by this work.
That any still-running baseline process is free of other latent defects; no baseline process was observed at report generation time.
